$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls02.INT: Use either the <font color='#FF9333'>W, A, S, D</font> keys or the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> to move and the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> to look around. Following on-screen Waypoints will guide you through the level.
$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls02.FRA: Utilise les <font color='#FF9333'>touches fléchées</font> (ou les touches <font color='#FF9333'>Z, S, Q, D</font>) pour te déplacer et la <font color='#FF9333'>souris</font> pour regarder autour de toi. Les relais qui apparaissent à l'écran t'aident à t'orienter dans le niveau.

$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls04.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to Jump. Double press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to Double Jump.
$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls04.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font> pour sauter. Appuie deux fois sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font> pour faire un double saut.

$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls06.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>F</font> pour changer de forme.

$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls08.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> to interact with certain objects in the world.
$UIText.Tutorials.BasicControls08.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> pour interagir avec certains objets de l'environnement.

$UIText.Tutorials.Combat02.INT: Your Combat Display is located in the upper right hand of the screen.  It displays your current weapon, total ammo, and grenades.  You can carry two weapons.  To switch between them, press <font color='#FF9333'>Page Up/Page Down</font> or use the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse Wheel</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Combat02.FRA: Ton interface de combat se trouve en haut à droite de l'écran. Elle indique ton arme actuelle ainsi que le total de munitions et de grenades disponibles. Tu peux transporter deux armes. Pour passer de l'une à l'autre, appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Pg. Préc/Pg. Suiv</font> ou utilise la <font color='#FF9333'>molette de la souris</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.Combat04.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> to reload your currently equipped weapon.  Hold <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> to pick up a new weapon.
$UIText.Tutorials.Combat04.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> pour recharger ton arme équipée. Maintiens <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> pour prendre une nouvelle arme.

$UIText.Tutorials.Combat06.INT: To shoot, click the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font>. The reticule represents the accuracy of your weapon. Continuous firing or jumping decreases weapon effectiveness.  To use Fine Aim, click the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Combat06.FRA: Pour tirer, appuie sur le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font>. Le réticule indique la précision de ton arme. Elle diminue lorsque tu tires en continu ou quand tu sautes. Pour utiliser la visée ajustée, maintiens le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton droit de la souris</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades02.INT: Heat-seeking mines that pursue any targets in range.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades02.FRA: Mines à tête chercheuse poursuivant toute cible à portée.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades04.INT: Explosive grenades that detonate on a fuse.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades04.FRA: Grenades explosant au bout d'un certain temps.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades06.INT: Flash bangs that blind and slow anyone within range.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades06.FRA: Grenades aveuglant et ralentissant tout ennemi à portée.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades08.INT: Grenades that spawn a healing aura when detonated.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenades08.FRA: Grenades produisant une aura régénérante lors de leur explosion.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenadesDesc.INT: To throw a grenade press <font color='#FF9333'>G</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatGrenadesDesc.FRA: Pour lancer une grenade, appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>G</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.CombatMeleeDesc.INT: To perform a quick melee strike click the <font color='#FF9333'>Middle Mouse Button</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.CombatMeleeDesc.FRA: Pour effectuer une attaque rapide en mêlée, appuie sur le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton central de la souris</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.CoolBarrierDesc.FRA: Déploie une barrière protectrice à l'énergon.

$UIText.Tutorials.CoolCloakingDesc.INT: Become nearly invisible on the battlefield.
$UIText.Tutorials.CoolCloakingDesc.FRA: Deviens quasiment invisible sur le champ de bataille.

$UIText.Tutorials.CoolDodgeDesc.FRA: Permet d'accélérer dans n'importe quelle direction.

$UIText.Tutorials.CoolHoverDesc.INT: Gives ability to hover in the air and increases weapon damage.
$UIText.Tutorials.CoolHoverDesc.FRA: Permet de planer et d'augmenter les dégâts des armes.

$UIText.Tutorials.CoolMarkTargetDesc.INT: Tags an enemy with an electromagnetic pulse which weakens their armor and reveals their location.
$UIText.Tutorials.CoolMarkTargetDesc.FRA: Marque un ennemi grâce à une impulsion électromagnétique qui affaiblit son blindage et dévoile sa position.

$UIText.Tutorials.Cooldown01.INT: Cooldown abilities are initially usable and replenish themselves after use over a cooldown timer.
$UIText.Tutorials.Cooldown01.FRA: Les compétences passant par un processus de refroidissement deviennent inutilisables pendant un certain temps après leur première utilisation.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerDrainDesc.FRA: Permet de siphonner l'énergie des ennemis.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerGuidedMissileDesc.FRA: Petite bombe nucléaire contrôlée à distance.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerShockwaveDesc.INT: Pushes enemies back and causes moderate damage.
$UIText.Tutorials.EnerShockwaveDesc.FRA: Repousse les ennemis tout en leur infligeant des dégâts modérés.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerSpawnMGSentryDesc.INT: Spawns a sentry, which can see cloaked enemies.
$UIText.Tutorials.EnerSpawnMGSentryDesc.FRA: Génère un Gardien capable de détecter les unités furtives.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerWarcryDesc.INT: Area of effect buffs armor and damage output.
$UIText.Tutorials.EnerWarcryDesc.FRA: Procure un bonus de blindage et de dégâts dans une certaine zone.

$UIText.Tutorials.EnerWhirlwindDesc.INT: Gives ability to do a Whirlwind melee attack.
$UIText.Tutorials.EnerWhirlwindDesc.FRA: Permet d'effectuer une attaque de mêlée tourbillonnante.

$UIText.Tutorials.Energon01.INT: Energon skills must be fueled with Energon shards before you can use them. Collect Energon shards dropped from fallen enemies to fuel the skills.  The skills come online when they turn white.
$UIText.Tutorials.Energon01.FRA: Les compétences utilisant de l'énergon doivent être alimentées avec des éclats d'énergon, que tu peux récupérer sur les ennemis vaincus. Ces compétences peuvent être utilisées quand elles deviennent blanches.

$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation01.INT: In Escalation, you fight cooperatively against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.
$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation01.FRA: En mode Escalade, tu affrontes en coop plusieurs vagues d'ennemis de plus en plus coriaces.

$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation02.INT: Earn Energon Power by destroying enemies. As the waves progress, more difficult enemies will give you more power to spend.
$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation02.FRA: Tu gagnes de l'énergon en éliminant des ennemis. Plus les vagues s'enchaînent et plus l'élimination de tes ennemis te permet d'accumuler de l'énergie.

$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation03.INT: Spend your Energon Power at various machines throughout the map to purchase ammo, health, weapons, and open doors to new areas.
$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation03.FRA: Parcours la carte et dépense ces points d'énergon dans diverses machines pour acheter des munitions et des armes, régénérer ton énergie et ouvrir la voie vers de nouvelles zones.

$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation04.INT: You can pool your points with other players to obtain higher cost items.
$UIText.Tutorials.Escalation04.FRA: Tu peux additionner tes points et ceux d'autres joueurs pour pouvoir acheter des objets plus onéreux.

$UIText.Tutorials.Health01.INT: Your health bar is located in the upper left hand corner of the screen. It is divided into multiple segments. As you take damage, you will lose Energon from each segment. If you stop taking damage before a segment is drained, it will regenerate.
$UIText.Tutorials.Health01.FRA: Ta jauge d'énergie se trouve en haut à gauche de l'écran. Elle est divisée en plusieurs segments, qui se vident de leur énergon lorsque tu subis des dégâts. Si tu cesses de subir des dégâts avant qu'un segment n'ait été complètement vidé de son énergon, il se régénère.

$UIText.Tutorials.Health02.INT: Once you drain a segment completely, you can only restore it by finding Energon Cubes or being healed.
$UIText.Tutorials.Health02.FRA: Quand un segment s'est complètement vidé, tu ne peux régénérer son énergon qu'en trouvant des cubes d'énergon ou en te faisant régénérer.

$UIText.Tutorials.Health03.INT: If you lose more than half of the last segment of health, your systems will start to shut down.
$UIText.Tutorials.Health03.FRA: Si tu perds plus de la moitié de ton dernier segment d'énergie, tes systèmes commenceront à se désactiver.

$UIText.Tutorials.Health04.INT: Find Energon Cubes quickly or take cover to restore your systems. In Co-op and Escalation, you can revive fallen players by being near them and holding <font color='#FF9333'>E</font>.  Abilities will be jammed briefly after revival.
$UIText.Tutorials.Health04.FRA: Trouve vite des cubes d'énergon ou mets-toi à couvert pour réparer tes systèmes. En mode Coop et Escalade, approche-toi d'un allié vaincu et maintiens <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> pour le réactiver. Les compétences sont brièvement bloquées après une réactivation.

$UIText.Tutorials.Pickups01.FRA: Détruis des caisses pour récupérer des objets.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles01.INT: Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot a rapid-fire machine gun. Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles01.FRA: Maintiens le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour tirer avec une mitrailleuse à cadence de tir élevée. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> pour la recharger.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles02.INT: In Hover mode, hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>W, S, A, D</font>) to Dash. In Boost mode, press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>A</font> or <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) to Barrel Roll. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles02.FRA: Quand tu planes, maintiens le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton droit de la souris</font> et une des <font color='#FF9333'>touches fléchées</font> (ou <font color='#FF9333'>Z, S, Q, D</font>) pour accélérer. En mode turbo, appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Maj</font> et sur une des <font color='#FF9333'>touches fléchées</font> (ou <font color='#FF9333'>Q </font> et <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) pour faire un tonneau. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font> pour sauter.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles03.INT: Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot the truck missiles.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles03.FRA: Appuie sur le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour tirer les missiles du camion. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> pour recharger.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles04.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> to Ram forward at high speed. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles04.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Maj</font> pour charger à grande vitesse. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font> pour sauter.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles05.INT: Jets are equipped with both homing rockets and machine guns.  Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> and switch weapons with <font color='#FF9333'>Page Up/Page Down</font> or the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse Wheel</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles05.FRA: Les jets sont équipés de roquettes autoguidées et de mitrailleuses. Appuie sur le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour tirer. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> pour recharger. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Pg. Préc/Pg. Suiv</font> ou utilise la <font color='#FF9333'>molette de la souris</font> pour changer d'arme.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles06.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>A</font> or <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) to Barrel Roll.  While in Hover mode, ascend with <font color='#FF9333'>C</font> and descend with <font color='#FF9333'>V</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles06.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Maj</font> et sur une des <font color='#FF9333'>touches fléchées</font> (ou <font color='#FF9333'>Q</font> et <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) pour faire un tonneau. Quand tu planes, appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>C</font> pour prendre de l'altitude et sur <font color='#FF9333'>V</font> pour redescendre.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles07.INT: Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot the tank cannon.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles07.FRA: Appuie sur le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour tirer avec le canon du blindé. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> pour recharger.

$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles08.INT: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> to perform a quick 180 turn. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
$UIText.Tutorials.Vehicles08.FRA: Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Maj</font> pour faire un demi-tour rapide. Appuie sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font> pour sauter.

$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic02.INT: Upon changing form all robots transition into vehicle Hover mode. While in this mode use the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>W, S, A, D</font>) to strafe and the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> to steer.
$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic02.FRA: Tous les robots passent par le mode planeur quand ils changent de forme. Quand tu planes, utilise les <font color='#FF9333'>touches fléchées</font> (ou <font color='#FF9333'>Z, S, Q, D</font>) pour te déplacer latéralement et la <font color='#FF9333'>souris</font> pour te diriger.

$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic04.INT: Vehicles can all perform a Jump by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic04.FRA: Tu peux sauter avec n'importe quel véhicule en appuyant sur <font color='#FF9333'>Espace</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic06.INT: All vehicles can move quickly by triggering Boost mode with the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font>.  While in this mode the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> will steer the vehicle while it is moving forward.
$UIText.Tutorials.VehiclesBasic06.FRA: Tous les véhicules disposent d'un turbo. Active-le avec le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton droit de la souris</font>. Dans ce mode, utilise la <font color='#FF9333'>souris</font> pour diriger ton véhicule pendant qu'il avance.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons02.INT: A rapid fire assault rifle with moderate spread.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons02.FRA: Fusil d'assaut caractérisé par une cadence de tir élevée et une faible dispersion.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons04.INT: A scoped, semi-automatic rifle that fires a three bullet burst.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons04.FRA: Fusil semi-automatique équipé d'une lunette tirant des rafales de trois coups.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons06.FRA: Mitraillette à cadence de tir élevée.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons08.INT: A powerful sniper rifle with a 10x scope.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons08.FRA: Puissant fusil de précision équipé d'une lunette 10x.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons10.FRA: Fusil semi-automatique pour le combat rapproché.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons14.INT: Fires sticky grenades that can be detonated by clicking the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font>.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons14.FRA: Tire des grenades collantes dont l'explosion peut être déclenchée d'un simple <font color='#FF9333'>clic droit</font>.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons16.INT: Full auto mini-gun. Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to spin up for maximum fire rate.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons16.FRA: Mitrailleuse automatique. Maintiens le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour faire tourner les canons et profiter d'une cadence de tir maximale.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons18.INT: Rocket launcher with vehicle lock-on capabilities. Train your reticule on a vehicle briefly to obtain a lock-on.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons18.FRA: Lance-roquettes anti-véhicules à verrouillage. Garde brièvement ton réticule sur un véhicule pour le verrouiller.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons20.INT: Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to charge before firing - the longer it is charged the more powerful the blast
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons20.FRA: Maintiens le <font color='#FF9333'>bouton gauche de la souris</font> pour charger l'arme avant de tirer. Plus elle est chargée, plus l'explosion sera puissante.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons22.INT: Short-range, lock-on beam weapon that heals teammates and damages enemies. When equipped you are able to see your allies' current health.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons22.FRA: Arme à courte portée avec faisceau de verrouillage qui régénère les coéquipiers ou endommage les ennemis. Quand tu es équipé de cette arme, tu peux voir l'énergie de tes alliés.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons24.FRA: Pistolet lourd semi-automatique équipé d'une lunette 5x.

$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons26.INT: Fires a rapid lightning blast with a large damage radius.
$UIText.Tutorials.Weapons26.FRA: Provoque de rapides explosions au rayon d'action important.

Tutorials.Health01: Your health bar is located in the upper left hand corner of the screen. It is divided into multiple segments. As you take damage, you will lose Energon from each segment. If you stop taking damage before a segment is drained, it will regenerate.
Tutorials.Health02: Once you drain a segment completely, you can only restore it by finding Energon Cubes or being healed.
Tutorials.Health03: If you lose more than half of the last segment of health, your systems will start to shut down.
Tutorials.Health04: Find Energon Cubes quickly or take cover to restore your systems. In Co-op and Escalation, you can revive fallen players by being near them and holding <font color='#FF9333'>E</font>.  Abilities will be jammed briefly after revival.
Tutorials.Energon01: Energon skills must be fueled with Energon shards before you can use them. Collect Energon shards dropped from fallen enemies to fuel the skills.  The skills come online when they turn white.
Tutorials.EnerWhirlwindDesc: Gives ability to do a Whirlwind melee attack.
Tutorials.EnerShockwaveDesc: Pushes enemies back and causes moderate damage.
Tutorials.EnerSpawnMGSentryDesc: Spawns a sentry, which can see cloaked enemies.
Tutorials.EnerWarcryDesc: Area of effect buffs armor and damage output.
Tutorials.Cooldown01: Cooldown abilities are initially usable and replenish themselves after use over a cooldown timer.
Tutorials.CoolMarkTargetDesc: Tags an enemy with an electromagnetic pulse which weakens their armor and reveals their location.
Tutorials.CoolCloakingDesc: Become nearly invisible on the battlefield.
Tutorials.CoolHoverDesc: Gives ability to hover in the air and increases weapon damage.
Tutorials.BasicControls02: Use either the <font color='#FF9333'>W, A, S, D</font> keys or the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> to move and the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> to look around. Following on-screen Waypoints will guide you through the level.
Tutorials.BasicControls04: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to Jump. Double press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to Double Jump.
Tutorials.BasicControls08: Press <font color='#FF9333'>E</font> to interact with certain objects in the world.
Tutorials.Combat02: Your Combat Display is located in the upper right hand of the screen.  It displays your current weapon, total ammo, and grenades.  You can carry two weapons. Tutorials.Weapons14: Fires sticky grenades that can be detonated by clicking the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font>.
Tutorials.Weapons16: Full auto mini-gun. Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to spin up for maximum fire rate.
Tutorials.Weapons18: Rocket launcher with vehicle lock-on capabilities. Train your reticule on a vehicle briefly to obtain a lock-on.
Tutorials.Weapons20: Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to charge before firing - the longer it is charged the more powerful the blast

Tutorials.Vehicles01: Hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot a rapid-fire machine gun. Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
Tutorials.Vehicles02: In Hover mode, hold the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>W, S, A, D</font>) to Dash. In Boost mode, press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>A</font> or <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) to Barrel Roll. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
Tutorials.Vehicles03: Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot the truck missiles.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
Tutorials.Vehicles04: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> to Ram forward at high speed. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
Tutorials.Vehicles05: Jets are equipped with both homing rockets and machine guns.  Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font> and switch weapons with <font color='#FF9333'>Page Up/Page Down</font> or the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse Wheel</font>.
Tutorials.Vehicles06: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> and a direction on the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>A</font> or <font color='#FF9333'>D</font>) to Barrel Roll.  While in Hover mode, ascend with <font color='#FF9333'>C</font> and descend with <font color='#FF9333'>V</font>.
Tutorials.Vehicles07: Press the <font color='#FF9333'>Left Mouse Button</font> to shoot the tank cannon.  Reload by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>R</font>.
Tutorials.Vehicles08: Press <font color='#FF9333'>Shift</font> to perform a quick 180 turn. Press <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font> to jump.
Tutorials.VehiclesBasic02: Upon changing form all robots transition into vehicle Hover mode. While in this mode use the <font color='#FF9333'>Arrow Keys</font> (or <font color='#FF9333'>W, S, A, D</font>) to strafe and the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> to steer.
Tutorials.VehiclesBasic04: Vehicles can all perform a Jump by pressing <font color='#FF9333'>Space</font>.
Tutorials.VehiclesBasic06: All vehicles can move quickly by triggering Boost mode with the <font color='#FF9333'>Right Mouse Button</font>.  While in this mode the <font color='#FF9333'>Mouse</font> will steer the vehicle while it is moving forward.

Tutorials.Health01: Your health bar is located in the upper left hand corner of the screen. It is divided into multiple segments. As you take damage, you will lose Energon from each segment. If you stop taking damage before a segment is drained, it will regenerate.
Tutorials.Health02: Once you drain a segment completely, you can only restore it by finding Energon Cubes or being healed.
Tutorials.Health03: If you lose more than half of the last segment of health, your systems will start to shut down.
Tutorials.Health04: Find Energon Cubes quickly or take cover to restore your systems. In Co-op and Escalation, you can revive fallen players by being near them and holding {x}.  Abilities will be jammed briefly after revival.
Tutorials.Energon01: Energon skills must be fueled with Energon shards before you can use them. Collect Energon shards dropped from fallen enemies to fuel the skills.  The skills come online when they turn white.
Tutorials.EnerWhirlwindDesc: Gives ability to do a Whirlwind melee attack.
Tutorials.EnerShockwaveDesc: Pushes enemies back and causes moderate damage.
Tutorials.EnerSpawnMGSentryDesc: Spawns a sentry, which can see cloaked enemies.
Tutorials.EnerWarcryDesc: Area of effect buffs armor and damage output.
Tutorials.Cooldown01: Cooldown abilities are initially usable and replenish themselves after use over a cooldown timer.
Tutorials.CoolMarkTargetDesc: Tags an enemy with an electromagnetic pulse which weakens their armor and reveals their location.
Tutorials.CoolCloakingDesc: Become nearly invisible on the battlefield.
Tutorials.CoolHoverDesc: Gives ability to hover in the air and increases weapon damage.

A1_IAC_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: The Autobot's capital city, Iacon, lies in ruins. Their leader, Zeta Prime, has been defeated. Led by an Autobot named Optimus, they must repel the Decepticons until a plan can be made.

A2_KON_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: News of Zeta Prime's survival spreads quickly as Optimus assembles a squad to infiltrate the prison in Kaon where Zeta is being kept and free their leader from Megatron's clutches.

A3_COR_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: The Core of Cybertron has been corrupted with Dark Energon. Acknowledging his rightful title, Optimus Prime leads the Autobots in a daring attempt to cleanse the Core and save their world.

A4_ORB_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Megatron's orbital station stands between survival and defeat as its weapon systems blast apart the evacuating ships. The Autobots must destroy the station for hope to live on.

A5_TRY_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: The mighty Decepticon Trypticon has fallen to Cybertron's surface, but it is far from defeated. The final fight is on! One shall stand, one shall fall.

D1_ORB_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Megatron and his Decepticons infiltrate a research station orbiting Cybertron, in search of a powerful new energy source known as Dark Energon.

D2_COR_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Megatron commands his newest recruit, Starscream, to activate the long dormant Energon Bridge on Cybertron. Once activated, he will create more Dark Energon to fuel his war.

D3A_IAC_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Iacon, home of the Autobots, must fall. Megatron commands his Decepticons to attack Iacon in search of the fabled Omega Key, which will give him access to the Core of Cybertron itself!

D3B_IAC_Base_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Zeta Prime has been captured and Iacon inches closer to falling, but the last guardian, Omega Supreme, has awoken. Megatron must find a way to defeat him if he wishes to reach the planet's core.

D5_OME_BASE_m TnDataProvider_MapInfo.Description: Omega Supreme is not so easily dispatched. He alone stands in the way of Megatron's ultimate victory. The time has come to prove the Decepticon's true might. To glory! All hail Megatron!
